text: Bait a switch. So, play a slightly fun matching game with a little bit of physics in the trailer you get stuck with in other games. Finally decide it's a fair enough time killer and you'll try it. Find yourself playing a far less interesting tap to match game?!?? Maybe the fairly fun one eventually unlocks. But why would you slog through a downgrade to find out? Bizarre decision.

okay so I thought it was a little slow but addictive at the start so...you carry on playing...and it gets better, as you level up you get more and more chances to improve you merging skills and so far I can't wait for my next fix...it's an energy based game which I like as it gives me time to take a break...but I love it. I am now a VIP X oh and adverts are when you need something so it's your choice whether you want to watch them...that's a great bonus.

the first 12 or so levels are really fun, you can progress easily and it's not so frustrating to merge things to complete orders and to get energy to play the mini games within. but as you progress it becomes incredibly annoying to complete orders and the level up dialogue is so long and boring, they just rehash the same sentiments over and over (u can turn it off tho) and it's hard to complete the daily tasks without paying (which i refuse to do) fun for a bit but not long term.

Played It Through An Ad it's not like the ad at all. just another one of those games that tries to draw you in with one style but then changes it completely once you've installed it. I was playing sliding cocktails down a shoot now. that was fun! once I installed it I'm matching tiles. I hate tile matching. then it took me to modifying a base on a beach like an RTS. definitely not what I signed up for.

This game is unplayable without spending real money. It is addictive and really fun gameplay for the first day then orders are impossible as the spawners don't provide items you need which depletes all of your energy straight away. Under 2 minutes on the game and you've ran out of things you can do without spending money for hours until the energy refills. If the game developers ditched the energy aspect they'd have a really brilliant game which people would spend hours and hours on.

As with many other games the initial playable game is nothing like the game you actually start off playing and that is wrong. The game is like Pyramid Selling only you can't really get anywhere in the game without purchasing items to help you get higher. I got to level 8 before getting bored. Once I'm bored, the game goes in the bin.

To be fair, it's. a pretty solid game. It passes a bit of time away which these kind of thing these apps are for. The bit that gets to me is that EVERY SINGLE TIME before playing the game you have to go through at least 8 pop ups of adverts or progress infographics. Logging in? Pop ups Run out of energy? Pop ups Go to your town map and back? Pop ups I appreciate that it's ad free and they need to generate income. But the push is too strong

Bought a pack worth £1.99, first charge came up with "Connection Error". When I tried again it came up with the same error. Checked my bank account straight after (last night) and neither charge had gone through. Checked again today and both are now on my bank account. Can't seem to find a way to get in touch with the devs either. Update: Found a support page and they're aware of the issue—you're supposed to screenshot the error. Otherwise, no refund. 👎 ETA: Yous are missing the point entirely.

Updating review. I bought a new phone. reinstalled the app to find that all my progress had been wiped. Sent a help request, got a reply asking for info. sent that a week ago and heard nothing. just as well I had never spent any money in the game. It's an ok game but nothing like the advert. there are no real instructions on how to progress once the board is full and it quickly gets monotonous. something to fill time if you're waiting for someone but not the best.

The game was fun and relaxing at first but the longer you play the less fun it becomes. The amount of it effort it requires to complete orders without buying anything is really off putting when I'm just trying to relax with a casual game. I can probably play for 5 minutes before I have to spend money. But overall its a fun game you just won't last long if you don't pay for it.

What a surprise, yet another game that is nothing like the one advertised. I thought it was a bubble (cocktail) shooter, but it opens with the usual low rent version of candy crush and no obvious way to cancel out of it to see what else it has to offer. Instant uninstall.

Do Not like the bulky, amatuer look.of the graphics, spoiled the game ..What has happened to the graphics?? No no.no - pls change them back pls... This game is initially fun; a calming way to relax in your down time and really gets the endorphins going. Once out of energy which occurs very quickly, urged to buy bundles to progress in any meaningful way.

Starts off an enjoyable and addictive game but it soon becomes apparent that decent rewards and challenges are unachievable without spending money. The app is constantly advertising ''paid for'' deals with pop ups. All the challenges are timed and they are constantly trying to get you to buy gems and energy. This game should be investigated!

enjoyable game and progression but unless you pay real cash you're getting 5 minutes play time every 5+ hours. I've spent 70 hours on this game now and it's clear that dispensers simply won't dispense required orders as a means to get you to buy more gems. for instance on my poker dispenser I was getting non stop dice when I didn't need it and spent almost 300 energy trying to get 2 sets of chips, wouldn't you know one set of the 2 chips required in the last 10 energy of that bundle. blatant

The game is fun, and the graphics are great, but it's also incredibly frustrating. The developers should focus on customer satisfaction instead of being stingy and allowing negative reviews to pile up while seemingly spending time and money on fake positive reviews to repair their rating. Just let us enjoy the game, make us feel appreciated for your support, and encourage us to keep playing in the long term. Happy players are far more likely to stay and continue supporting the game.

This is my favourite advert to play. No matter what I'm doing, I stop to play this ad when it pops up. The game though? Absolutely nothing like it. Launching and merging cocktails like the ad is great fun. I could play it all day. Matching tiles, which is the actual game, not very fun. I wish I could just play the game in the ad 😕

It's an awesome game, very relaxing, also brilliant graffics. However, it takes 4 to 8 "power bolts" which in my opinion is ridiculous. I guess this is the way to force people to spend money on the game. If you don't spend, you can't achieve the tasks that could give you few free items and you also miss out on the rewards. If this carries on, I'm going to delete the game.

This is NOT the game from the ad, and although the game starts off fun enough, pretty soon you're either out of energy or waiting for the spawners to cool down (why two inhibitors??). Then the game keeps berating you with ads to buy packs to improve your experience. Disappointing, as the game starts off a lot of fun, then you can burn through your entire energy quota in seconds and have to wait for hours for it to get replenished.

Most merge games have items that take longer than others to attain. However, I've almost given up hope of ever attaining the item I need from the ice-cream truck. I'm not sure why you've included a story (usually the best part of merge-story games), as the captions move so fast it's difficult to read and makes you lose interest. Thirdly there are far too many ads with no volume button. It's intolerable and intrusive. Overall unimpressed.

A funny game of clicking things and dragging them together to make other things. Not anything like the advert that made me download it. I did try to get somewhere, but it just seems like more of the same ad infinitum. There are some buttons on the screen, but I can't work out what they do. And now I'm stuck, can't go forward, no idea how to go back. . Uninstalled.

Not as shown on the trailer/ ad. Game isn't bad, but gets slower & harder without paying for resources. Several different modes coming up, but they changed too often, plus crucially, no sign of the mode shown on the ad which is what I ACTUALLY wanted to play. Plus too many pop ups while playing. One review that said the mode in the trailer eventually shows up. But my patience ran out before then. Plus if the early game is an indicator it'll prob only be a small part of the game. Uninstalled

Fun, but I generally won't pay to play any game. I will watch videos. This game offers that option. It gets a bit frustrating to get close to a goal & then not reach it for several days. I do play 2x dly. Sometimes more. Have figured out full energy renews about every 3.5 hrs. The trading cards are just annoying. If there were teams within the game, maybe. But I don't want to go to a different site to find people to trade with. Going to FB for a bit extra is okay.

The core game play is really fun (although NOT the game in the advertising I saw). However, the number of side games is excessive. What I find really irritating is the pop ups. On average, when you log in to the game, you will see a pop up for every side game which you have to X before you can get to main game play. Usually it is about 5 pop ups but it can be up to NINE before you can even play. It is infuriating. The game crashes constantly. Today, it has loaded then crashed 8 times...

This is a great game but it becomes impossible to play. You don't get enough energy, it runs out so quickly! You have to wait hours for it to replenish and also really limited rewards. The mini games are good though and do help a bit. Heavily pushing you to pay, which I'm not doing. So I end up playing less. This is so nearly amazing. Please be more generous with the gems.

I recently played a different merge game. This feels like a cheap knock-off version. I don't know exactly why, but it's just not engaging. There's too much going on, but everything is frustratingly slow. There are too many generators, which quickly become obsolete and before you can make anything you need, the generators are on cool down. There is no time indication, so you have no idea how long you need to wait. The AI characters are disturbing. I just didn't like anything about this game

Downloaded the game for the false advertisement of the Suika game. Kept playing because it was idle fun. But it's reached the point where it's more frustrating than enjoyable, so I'm finally uninstalling it. If you want people to keep playing increase the energy cap when you go up levels. Stop the insane money grab. Lower the amount of energy it takes to fill every single order. It just stops being fun, then people stop playing. No players=no $

Honestly I just wanted to play the drink glass sliding game that showed up in the ad and is featured on the page. But I feel like I've put a couple hours in and I've received no hint that that game is showing up, even as a side mode, any time soon. What's actually here is... fine, but not what I wanted and I feel pretty deceived by the advertisement showcasing a minigame that is either not actually here or buried behind multiple hours of idle merger stuff.

money making game that when you get to level 25, the fun stops. it's exciting at first cause you get loads of energy and coins with diamonds but when you get to level 25, the daily challenges are ridiculous to achieve. you have to constantly be on the game to get anything and trying to level up is a right bore. need to start making it a little easier or people will just stop playing

NOT AS ADVERTISED. MISLEADING. Not the drinks merge. You have to collect coins by merging items in order to build buildings. Once the building is built nothing happens. You have several levels for each building and then nothing. The buildings are just for show too. No access to other games. The drinks game is nowhere to be found. I gave it a fair go but I'm deleting my account and uninstalling. *The in-game customer services do not allow screenshots to be added as requested 🤦

this game has repeatedly not given me the rewards that I've earned playing the game. This is especially frustrating when I've paid for some additional features to get additional rewards. I've reported this and provided evidence, which they've accepted, but still not resolution. They're quick enough to take my money, but not to resolve the issue.

For a merge game it is not bad. Energy replenishes itself at a decent rate and prices for extras are pretty low. However, the ads I have seen for this game advertised it as a collection of different launch and merge games similar to their image 1. At level 30 I am yet to see this type of merge game. For ads that specify 'no fake ads' in some of their ads, I'm disappointed to find this one has done a bait and switch.

The moment you spend money on this game, it becomes impossible to play without spending more money. Eventually, all the orders will be ones that cost hundreds of energy to produce- and the game's free energy caps at 100. You'll produce 1-tenth of an item and already run out. At that point, it takes days to fill a single order- when every single order requires 600-900 energy to produce a single item, you either pay or don't play

Downloaded this just for passing time in the evening but it isn't worth it. You make a few moves and then you have to wait hours. You can earn a few free rewards each day, but for me, at least once a day the ad closes and it tells me I have to finish the ad to get the reward, so I don't get it. When I contracted support, they straight up told me I DID get my reward...uhh, no, I didn't. That is poor business. It is a free game and you are really going to be that cheap? Scam to get you to spend $

I wanted to play the sliding drinks game that was heavily marketed to me in their playable ads. I was even willing to spend over a week grinding through the dull merge game to get to it... but I've been running out of patience and so I just now searched how to unlock it... and discovered that it's been entirely removed from the game in an update months ago!!! 😡

It's a fun matching game to waste time on. They have several side quests games that you can play competitively or choose the non competitive side games. As usual yes to in app purchases to buy energy or diamonds depending on how long you want to play in one sitting but I believe you can get 100 energy every 3 hours if you don't/can't spend the money or run out of diamonds to trade for energy. I like the game & play it everyday. It's a good game, go download it and have some fun!

Rubbish misleading game. Downloaded game was nothing like the ad. I kept playing because it was a fun time waster. Now I'm at level 35 and it is impossible to finish tasks and get the right items in the time frame without spending money buying extra turns. I also get sick of 10 pop up "buy this package" ads every time I open the game or press past my energy limit. I have uninstalled.

The game has nice graphics and is very generous with rewards. At first I was frustrated because there's no way to put items into the upper storage. But after a while I found out that's the reason why I became more decisive, and not wasting too much time on circulation. That also means less addiction and less time spending on playing all day. So 5 stars.

I've been playing this game for about a month, and I can truly say that it has truly made downtime me enjoyable. You will have to purchase pink diamonds & energy bolts (that's what I called them), but if you have a good game strategy, you can get free items that will allow you to pay less. After certain levels, you do play the game as advertised. Overall, I love this game. As I play more, z I'll update .... I recommend that you try it. Give it a chance (more than a few weeks).

I thought this was the sliding drinks game, but it turned out to be a completely different game. It's just another merge game, which is honestly exhausting. You have to merge through so many levels just to complete a single order. One order can easily take multiple rounds of 100 energy. Once your 100 energy runs out, you have to wait around 3 hours for it to refill. The game constantly pushes you to buy more energy, and it's very expensive. Just like many other reviews have said, this game feels

it can be fun I'm a teen and have little time to do it so when I miss one day I can't make up for it, it take 2 minutes to earn 1 energy and I'm on level 57 I've been playing the game for a couple of months I didn't mind the misleading ad but this is crazy. and it takes for ever to complete some orders and when I need an item it doesn't give it too me?? and you should still add to the energy's not just stop at 100 that goes fast. thank you

I love merge games and find this game fun and would love to rate it 5 stars, but I can't because the "rewards" aren't all free. It's like winning a contest and having to buy your trophy. This is in regards to the Cosmic Quest. The first few "rewards" for your hard work are paid for with the stars that you earn, and then suddenly, it's $1.99 USD to redeem the rest of the "rewards". I am not talking about the free side vs paid side. I am talking about the main quest.

​I downloaded this game because the ads looked really fun and interesting. But as soon as I opened it, I realized it is a completely different game. The gameplay from the ads is nowhere to be found. ​Instead, the actual game is just annoying and irritating to play. It’s full of constant interruptions, bad mechanics, and feels like a cheap trick just to get people to download it. ​Don't waste your time or phone space on this. Extremely disappointing.

Still dont understand why they do an ad on other game where you can play and its fun to end up downloading and playing something completely different... Reply : I can not add screenshot to my review, something very similar to the first image of the app, but instead of cocktails, was ice-creams. The ad was from chess. Seen other comments saying this minigame have been deleted

This game works really hard at trying to prevent you from playing it. It is constantly forcing popup interruptions, most of which are annoying mini-games, some of which you cannot x out of without going through the mini game tutorial, even if you've done it before. For the small amount of time you can play, the game itself is enjoyable, but the constant interruptions are irritating (no opt out available) and energy takes time to rebuild.

Run-of-the-mill merging game like Merge Mansion (is there a dev template for this or something?). Not necessarily a bad thing, but it is really annoying when the ad is nothing like the game. As others have said, the ad is like a suika game where you slide these beautiful neon drinks to make more. Way more interesting than the millionth merge game I've found.

The game is pretty fun to play just for passing time. But i have this problem. i wanted to play more, but due to the fact that i can not watch ads in order to gain more energy, it really frustrates me. And the game looks very soulless. without a proper story line nor better character design. i feel creep out. (Not asking to change the story)

Most satisfying merge game so far. Not overwhelmed by side tasks, ads, or a large map/land area. Goals are quickly achievable. Level 40 reached within 20 days of passive play, and the game hasn't slowed down or made advancement impossible without a purchase. In-app purchases are pretty reasonable, which adds to its no pressure play experience. It does take up a large amount of space, so my cheap store phone model does crash on occasion, but not a big deal as it doesn't result in any great loss.

Fun game, but it requires too much spending money to fully enjoy it. Paid rewards can only be claimed within a very short time, which makes purchases feel wasted if you miss them. Also, the required target items often don't appear from suppliers, making progress frustrating. Good concept, but the balance between gameplay and spending needs improvement.

I had to lower my stars because I'm a little sad! I like this game a lot, I've been having fun! It's cute and kills time and you don't have to spend money or watch ads if you don't want to. But whenever I'm done for the time being and go to close out the app for a bit, when I come back whatever I did last just... Is undone. Example the last time it happened was today, I had gotten 20 gems earlier. When I came back just now, those 20 gems were gone and I have no clue how to get them back.

An interesting game at first, but as you progress, you realise that you don't enjoy the game as much without making in-app purchases. A lot of the time, you make purchases and your transaction declines, but your account is debited. You report to the app developers, they refer you to Google Play, and Google Play refers you right back to the developers. Both give you the runaround for your money and nothing gets resolved. If you're going to play, DO NOT MAKE IN-APP PURCHASES! IT'S A SCAM!!

Near impossible to complete challenges without paying real money!!! this game was super fun when I first started but now as I leveled it seems like a money grab. Not even fun anymore at this point. Spent almost 1,000 energy and still couldn't get but a few items to complete a challenge because the items just aren't dropping. It starts to limit drops of items you are needing when it knows they are needed for orders. I will likely delete this game soon. Don't recommend.

Wish I'd read reviews first to see that the playable ad that was fun doesn't actually exist in the game. Watch an ad, click the 'reward granted' and get told you didn't actually watch the whole ad so no reward. Instructions are nowhere to be found; I get the match/merge part, but anything else is a guess. Lots of purchase offers but nothing to tell me what is inside the chest you want me to buy? Yeah, no thanks.

A great way to turn my mind OFF. As a busy corporate professional and mom, sometimes I just want to wind down and not think for a while and this game helps me do that. Merging items to fulfill orders and build the city is like playing multiple games at once. The side quests are pretty fun too, especially after running out of energy. I can't give it 5 stars because it takes too much energy to merge enough to fulfill items. A bit overkill in my opinion.

NOT what it used to be I only downloaded this game bc of the sliding drinks feature... that whole part of the game has been REMOVED. ALSO, the amount of pop ups in this game that appear before you can even play is ACTUALLY mind-boggling! I kid you not, you have to go thru maybe 15 pop us, and some dont let you skip and will take you to other mini games before you can close. It's INCREDIBLY frustrating every time I play. with the sliding drinks part, the game get extremely repetitive and boring.

Not enough energy. At first, 100 energy is just fine, but after a few days of play, it hardly gets anything. Play for a few minutes, then wait hours. The in-game rewards rarely give energy, and the newest only is only 2... which you can't do anything with. The daily rewards are unattainable past your first week of playing. How can I fill 120 orders when I can't get even one order fill with 100 energy? Loved the game at first, but would not recommend as beyond a week, your energy isn't enough.

Love the game. But at higher levels it's 100% pay to play. Spent 400 energy, I did not get close to what I needed. I'm referring to either a secondary spawner, or a less frequent spawned item. When you do not need them, they are plentiful. When you need them, they become VERY rare. I'll keep playing it but I'm not spending another nickel on this game.

The game is fine to pass time, free to play if you're patient. BUT the seemingly random events are set (the treasure chest minigame has a set number of turns for each round & the dance party sale always gives the same reward on the free spin). However, I honestly hate that every time I open the game, I have to click through pop-ups! Yes, I know there's a weekly event, I'm halfway through. Yes, there's a sale. And another event. And daily goals. I have now wasted my break closing pop-ups...

I downloaded this game because my significant other LOVED the drink sliding mini game ad. I began playing this game in hopes of unlocking this game once I got far enough in the levels to fully upgrade the bar. Each building on the map should have a mini game that starts up once you click on it that you play to gain more energy for the main merging board. At the very LEAST the game should contain the game that is presented to the public in the ad, otherwise it is false advertising. Please add it.

I downloaded the game for the shuffleboard game from the ads. I'm so sick of games like this making up a fun game for the ads then being completely different. If you've seen an ad, the only similarity that has to the game is it's the same art style, do not download. I would give 0 stars if I could.

Booting up this game is so obnoxious. You have to click 75,000 times dismissing so many event notifications and enduring pointless tutorials from that raccoon thing about things you don't care about before it will allow you to play. Let me turn all that off, it's so annoying. I happily support the game monetarily because I enjoy it, let me play it, jeez.

I just wanted to play the drink sliding game that's featured in the ads. This game, however, does NOT contain that game. Those ads are false. What is here is just a typical bland merge game with hours of waiting for new items to be made available. Wish I read the reviews first since this seems to be the number one complaint. This game is an easy pass.

worst game ever .. This game is very disappointing because nothing is like it was shown in the advertisement. The ads make the game look exciting and interesting, but the actual gameplay is completely different. Many features shown in the ads are either missing or fake. It feels misleading and creates false expectations for players. Overall, the game is not enjoyable as promised, and my experience was not good.”

The game was fun at first. I agree with most of the comments about the cost of items and the difficulty filling orders. I'm really disappointed that the demo game does not exist in the game at all. The one with the drinks on the table, merging and growing. where is it? I would like to not have to spend money for energy and gems.

this game is so fun and addictive. Not sure why there are so many complaints about needing to spend real money to play...I'm level 23 and haven't had an issue. If you are inpatient and don't want to wait for your energy to build up that's a "you" problem. It's great to play a fun game with no ads and very cute graphics. There are also lots of events that keep you wanting to play. cool game.

The game is good, enjoyable to play. However, the in-game bonus energy is far too low, and the prices are absolutely too high. I only purchased it once, and I regret it because it didn't improve my gameplay at all. It's both very expensive and requires a long wait of about 3 hours for energy. We can't play the game freely. There's actually a lot to write about, but the game is completely money-hungry... The game is good, But every game gets ruined because of greedy developers.

I've been playing this game for months now, and since the most recent June update on 6/18, I have not received 1 single "new" card to complete the 2 sets that are both missing 1 card each. it has been almost 2 weeks of no new cards, and I find this incredibly frustrating. 1 sfar until they fix this.

I won't lie, it's a fun game, but the push to make in-app purchases is insane. Yes, I have purchased gems to buy energy , but as I've gotten further into the game, it seems like it's almost impossible to advance without doing so. I have stopped doing any "task" that I know will eat up energy points and stick to basic advancing.

Fun but can't really play unless you pay. When you get past the first couple of spawners, the orders are purposely kept way out of reach unless you pay to play. After trying for over 3 days to get rings from a 2nd spawner & it giving me nothing but tiki heads (I have 3 full/useless now), I deleted the app. You have to wait hours to get any sort of replenishment of energy. The survey ads never work, they always say you didn't watch the full ad no matter what you do.

I would give it a zero if I could. I encountered a rather fun playable add for a merge & shoot game focused on drinks. the add then lead me to this game so I installed it. This is a completely different game and not quite my cup of tea. This creator seems to have another game similar to what I described, but that is also not the same game. I'm giving it a low rating simply because I feel duped and am very disappointed that I can't play the game from the add.

I agree with other reviews; this game starts out kind of fun, but once you're out of energy you have to wait hours for it to refill. Of course they hit you with back to back offers to spend real money to buy energy. Also, if you're downloading because you've seen this advertised in other games? It's nothing like the ads.

Bait and switch. Not the game I thought I was getting. I thought I was getting the game from the ad: 'slide the drink on the table/board and combine/merge it with another of same kind to make the new drinks game. Merge game is fun, but as others have mentioned, too much 'energy' needed to fill orders. I don't read all of the dialogue when you build.

it's a fun game but not at all like the advertisement... I just want to play but the limited energy per action is obnoxious, I'd rather just play and enjoy the side quests, how the main game is designed... it's more like a chore I play games to help navigate trauma and I'm limited to how many games I can keep on my device, so I'm more frustrated than I'd hoped for and probably won't keep the game much longer which is unfortunate

Game is enjoyable but not what was advertised. I played a sample in another app &download to find out it's not the same game. Limit of 4 ads per day to get energy. I would watch more if they allowed it.Same w/ the bubbles, only 1 ad watch per day to pop a bubble item. I would watch more to get more free items.The ads in game for the actual app offering deals if you pay- WAY too many. I was already getting three every time I ran out of energy now it's 5-6. I will delete game if it continues

What was a 5 star game became more predatory and less enjoyable. I have experienced the returns from in-game rewards as they went from abundant to paltry. That experience has been disheartening. The game has been pushing towards microtransactions and has become a chore. It truly was fun, but not anymore.

Decent game to pass the time with. Somewhat addicting and therapeutic. The one suggestion I have is to create a separate page for the item rewards (top left part of the carousel row) so that they can visually see all the item rewards they can access. Also why can't you backpack time boosters so that users can decide when to use them? Currently if you have a time booster showing as the next item reward, I am not able to access the other item rewards I have stockpiled underneath the time booster

It's been almost 3 WEEKS since I've emailed the developer with no reply. Even though my account was linked to my Facebook, it still reset my Account ID and game to Level 1 when I switched to a new phone. I've made 19 purchases playing this game and Google Play shows I've spent the most hours playing this game over all other games in the past year--288.1 hrs to be exact. This is because it's the only game I play daily. At this point I'm going to be contacting Google for help. I'm beyond annoyed.

The game is alot of fun for a while... then higher levels require you to pay for gems or stamina to continue to play... unless you want to wait up to 24 hours for more stamina to play. If you are not willing to PAY TO PLAY (to complete orders) please find another game. Yes it is fun... but at a cost for a "free game"

I downloaded it for the drinks game from the ad, which it does not have, it's just a boring merge game like thousands of other similar games. Also, I keep having the review removed, I keep getting a message that the review is not respecting the policy, yet there is nothing breaking the policy. Let's see if this review gets through.

Fun for first week. after the first week then making progress takes forever unless you want to pay / buy merge items. so every day your stars reset and you can play for 10 minutes then you have to wait few hours to get points back then you can play for 5 mins. Even after spending about 10.00 it only gave my additional play for about 30 minutes total. there has to be some better game out there. if it ever changes please let me know

First I downloaded this game for the drinks shuffleboard that kept popping up on my other game. Not only did this game not have it but it's nearly impossible to complete any of the challenges without spending money. You get a full 100 energy every 3 1/2 hours . I've been playing for 4 months and can't finish a challenge. good luck getting 120 orders in 7 days. I play 5-6 times a day and I've never completed collecting all the cards either. If you have deep pockets this is the game for you!!

its a nice game and they will help get your account back if you switch phones if possible. however I feel like they want money too much. its expensive out here and trying to relax and play a game feels nice but waiting 2 mins per one energy is annoying 😑 and 1.99 for some energy and diamonds seems low but too expensive after a bit because of how fast the energy goes if you really want to play the game..

I downloaded this game because of the drink shuffleboard. At first I couldn't get enough of this game even though the drink shuffleboard wasn't there.
